answer: The haven counter is kept in yarrow and zephyr shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 48 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An attacker hence has to keep every alias continuously active for 48 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 3634 identities would post 3625 proofs and burn roughly 49 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
